description: Real DeepSeek/Aionis evaluation tasks against the focused Aionis Runtime source tree. These tasks mutate isolated workspace copies and verify real source contracts, not fixtures.

tasks.title: Promote the Lite sandbox route group into the required runtime route matrix
tasks.prompt: Aionis Lite now treats the local sandbox route group as a required validation substrate for real replay and repair review flows. Update the focused runtime source so the Lite route matrix reports the sandbox route group as required instead of leaving it out of the kernel-required routes. Keep admin/control unavailable in Lite, and keep the change scoped to the route matrix/runtime boundary source. Run the verifier before finishing.

tasks.title: Expose the sandbox session route in the public SDK shared route map
tasks.prompt: A host integration needs the public SDK shared route map to expose the sandbox session creation endpoint instead of hardcoding that path. Add a stable shared route constant for creating memory sandbox sessions. Do not reintroduce the removed automation SDK surface. Keep the change scoped to the public SDK route map. Run the verifier before finishing.
